title: Progress Report
description: The AI student progress report: CEFR estimate, skill matrix, strengths and growth areas, learning styles, next steps, narrative and evidence counts. Replaces the bulk PDF/ZIP export (BulkReportExport.tsx + reportPdf.ts) and the browser-print copy (AIReportDialog.tsx); content from ReportDocument.tsx. 1.1.0 adds the family copy (variant family): English with Vietnamese, the approved level only, no staff analysis.

full.description: Generous layout: two-column skill matrix, strengths and growth areas side by side, the narrative in its own panel. Original order throughout.

compact.description: Tighter layout aimed at fewer pages: three-column skill matrix, learning styles beside next steps. Same text, same order.

family.description: The family's copy, English with Vietnamese: a proud moment, the period's figures, the approved level only, can-do statements with evidence, at most two next goals with what the teacher does in class, things to do at home, questions to ask, the next period's goal and the teacher's note. No model estimate, confidence, growth areas, teacher next steps or evidence counts.
